description: cfd_2d_dambreak_onestep with N 66 1.1 (patch 0178): a step is repeated with half the time step when the time step after it is below 1/1.1 of it. 5 steps are repeated with half the time step in the 80 steps (a low ratio, so that the short run has repeats; 2 is the value for a run).
covers: the time step of a repeated step
